#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    vector<int> res(need, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); ++i) {
        long long ai = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b.size(); ++j) {
            long long bj = (b[j] % mod + mod) % mod;
            long long prod = (ai * bj) % mod;
            res[i + j] = (res[i + j] + (int)prod) % mod;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }

    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p % 2 != 0) {
            ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
        }
        p /= 2;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
    }

    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        long long sq = (long long)x * x % MOD;
        res = (res + sq) % MOD;
    }
    cout << (int)res << endl;

    return 0;
}
